dash.title: Dashboard
dash.shiftClosed: No shift is open. Open one in Point of sale.
dash.attnExpired: {{count}} expired lot(s) still in stock. Quarantine or write them off.

onb.title: Welcome, {{name}}
onb.lede: A few quick steps to get your pharmacy ready. Safety controls are on from day one.
onb.branchLicenceHint: As issued by the health authority
onb.catalogueReady: {{count}} drugs are available to start with.
onb.catalogueEmpty: The catalogue is empty. Add drugs from the Catalogue page.
onb.safetyNote: Expiry, recall and quarantine blocks, prescription checks, controlled-medicine logging and pharmacist sign-off are always on, in every plan. They cannot be switched off.

cat.title: Drug catalogue
cat.subtitle: Every product, its price book and the substitutes you can offer.
cat.emptyHint: Try a different name, ingredient or barcode.
cat.noPriceHint: Add the first price below; it applies from the date you choose.
cat.noSubstitutesHint: No other product shares this active ingredient and strength.
cat.subsHint: Same active ingredient and strength, cheapest first
cat.packUnitHint: 1 unit = N base units; use them when receiving or selling in boxes.

inv.title: Inventory
inv.controlledWitness: Controlled medicine: a second staff member must countersign.
inv.transferNeedsChain: Inter-branch transfers need the Chain plan.

rcv.title: Receiving
rcv.empty: Scan or search to add items
rcv.subtitle: Scan or search products, check lot and expiry, then book them into stock.
rcv.emptyHint: Scan a GS1 barcode or search a product to add the first line.

rx.title: Prescriptions
rx.allergiesHint: Active ingredients or classes, comma separated (e.g. penicillin)
rx.scan: Scan or photo of the prescription
rx.substitutionConsent: Patient consents to this substitution (pharmacist decision)
rx.subtitle: Intake, verification, repeats and transfers — works without Kiorly.
rx.prescribersEmpty: No prescribers yet — they are added as you enter prescriptions.
rx.search: Search patient, prescriber or Rx no.

disp.title: Dispensing
disp.start: Run safety checks and reserve stock
disp.startNote: Interaction, allergy, duplicate, dose, prescriber and controlled-limit checks always run. Lots are reserved first-expiry-first-out.
disp.none: Start dispensing from the prescription to see safety checks and sign-off here.
disp.overrideWarn: Your name and the reason are recorded in the dispensing record.
disp.nationalIdHint: 14 digits. Only the last 4 are kept readable.
disp.resolveBlocks: Resolve or override every blocked check first.
disp.pharmacistOnly: Only a licensed pharmacist can sign off.
disp.prepaid: Prepaid on Kiorex. No payment at the counter.
disp.lotBlocked: A reserved lot was blocked (recall, quarantine or expiry). Pick other lots.

pos.title: Point of sale
pos.needShift: Open a shift to start selling.
pos.scan: Scan barcode or type a name
pos.noCatalogue: The offline catalogue is empty. Connect once to load it.
pos.rxNote: Prescription-only and controlled medicines are dispensed from
pos.rxRequired: This item needs a prescription. Use the Rx queue.
pos.offlineCashOnly: Only cash or customer credit can be taken offline.
pos.negativeStock: Selling more than the stock on hand needs manager approval. It is recorded.
pos.refundApproval: Returns and voids need manager approval.
pos.savedOfflineLong: No connection. The sale is saved on this device and will sync automatically.
pos.vatNote: VAT lines are shown for your accountant only. Kiorly does not report to any tax authority.
pos.conflictsHelp: Sales rung up offline that could not be applied as queued (for example the lot was recalled meanwhile). Nothing was lost: decide how to settle each one.
pos.couponInvalid: Coupon not valid for this cart: {{codes}}
pos.xReportNote: Live snapshot of the open shift — does not close it.

sup.title: Purchasing
sup.liteNote: Purchase orders, supplier credit and auto-reorder are part of the Pro plan. Recalls and receiving are always available.
sup.name: Name
sup.recallNote: Entering a recall blocks every matching lot in all branches immediately.
sup.lotNumbersHint: As printed on the pack, comma separated
sup.emptyHint: Add the wholesalers you buy from to track balances and payments.
sup.noReorderHint: Everything is above its minimum level.
sup.posEmptyHint: Create orders from the reorder suggestions.
sup.recallsEmptyHint: A recall blocks the affected lots instantly and lists them here.
sup.subtitle: Suppliers, purchase orders, reorder suggestions and recalls.

ord.title: Kiorex orders
ord.subtitle: Respond before the SLA runs out. Prescription orders need pharmacist validation first.
ord.acceptHint: Set the quantity you can supply for each line. Anything below the requested amount makes this a partial order.
ord.emptyHint: New Kiorex orders appear here the moment they arrive.
ord.rejectHint: Shared with the customer. Be brief and clear.

rep.title: Reports
rep.vatNote: Exports are for you and your accountant. Kiorly never submits tax or invoice data to any authority.
rep.subtitle: Sales, stock and compliance reports with one-click export.
rep.markerHint: The tick marks each supplier's credit limit

set.title: Settings
set.rbacNote: Roles control what each person can do. Only licensed pharmacists can sign off dispensing.
set.vatHint: Market default {{default}}. Shown on receipts and exports only.
set.ownerPhoneHint: For expiry, recall and shift alerts
set.noTaxNote: Kiorly never connects to or reports to any tax authority. Your pharmacy issues its own fiscal documents.
set.marketplaceNote: Opt each branch in to receive Kiorex orders. Controlled medicines are never offered.
set.safetyNotFlags: Safety controls (expiry/recall/quarantine blocks, Rx checks, controlled log, pharmacist sign-off, audit, tenant isolation) are not feature flags and cannot be switched off.
set.inboxNote: WhatsApp, SMS and email are simulated until real providers are connected. Messages appear here instead of being sent.
set.subtitle: Your pharmacy, team and Kiorex marketplace preferences.
set.rolesNote: What each role can do, as enforced by the server. To change a person's access, change their role under Staff.
set.staffPhoneHint: International format, e.g. +201000002004. Links this person's Kiorex Passport on their first Passport sign-in.
set.staffPhoneInvalid: Use the international format: + then country code and number.
set.staffPassportNote: Sign-in with Kiorex Passport maps a verified phone number to one staff member. Role, branch and permissions always come from here, never from Passport.
set.passportLinkedHint: Linked to a Kiorex Passport. Changing the number does not unlink it.
set.passportPendingHint: Not linked yet. The first sign-in with Passport using this verified number links it.
set.newPasswordHint: Leave empty to keep the current password.
set.modeStandaloneNote: Everything runs on this pharmacy's own data. No Kiorly or Kiorex service is contacted: no marketplace orders, no e-prescription intake.
set.modeIntegratedNote: Turns on the optional Kiorex order inbox, e-prescription intake and the outbox. Needs an integration client from Kiorex.
set.taxRates: Tax rates (shown on receipts and exports only)
set.printersNote: Printing uses your browser's print dialog; choose the matching printer there.
set.rolesEditable: Click a cell to grant or revoke a permission for a role. Locked cells are safety-critical or owner-only.

imp.title: Import data from CSV
imp.fix: Fix the errors and check again — nothing is imported while any row has an error.
imp.stockBranch: Branch (when the file has no branchCode)

exp.title: Backup & export
exp.note: Download your own data any time. The full backup is one JSON file; spreadsheets are CSV for your accountant. Nothing is sent anywhere.

set.signinHint: Both methods stay available on the sign-in page. This only chooses which one is preselected for your team.
set.signinAutoHint: Kiorex Passport when this organisation is linked to Kiorex, otherwise Password.
set.signinOwnerOnly: Only the organisation owner or an administrator can change this.

pur.varEmpty: No cost variances in this period

fin.subtitle: Sales, margin, expenses, payables, receivables and insurer claims in one place. Exports are for your accountant — nothing is sent to any authority.

kiorexConnect.title: Connect to Kiorex
kiorexConnect.subtitle: Kiorly Pharmacy works fully on its own. When you are ready, finish these steps and ask Kiorex to register your pharmacy so patients can order from you.
kiorexConnect.legacy: Your pharmacy is already connected to Kiorex.

subscription.title: Active subscription
subscription.hint: Your Kiorly subscription must be active or on trial.

branch_optin.title: Branch opt-in
branch_optin.hint: Opt at least one branch in to Kiorex orders.

catalogue.title: Catalogue and prices
catalogue.hint: At least one in-stock, priced, non-controlled item. Unpriced items are never promised.

hours_delivery.title: Hours, delivery and map pin
hours_delivery.hint: Each opted-in branch needs opening hours, a map pin and its delivery or collection settings. Set them in the branch form under step 2.

licence.title: Licence documents
licence.hint: Every opted-in branch has its licence number, and the licence document is uploaded.

payout.title: Payout details placeholder
payout.hint: A short label for where payouts go. Bank details are never stored here; the payment partner collects them at onboarding.

terms.title: Marketplace terms
terms.hint: Accept the Kiorex marketplace terms. Fees follow the published market schedule.

request.title: Request partner registration
request.hint: Kiorex checks your credentials, runs a signed handshake and reviews your licence. Approval is by a person.

live.title: Live on Kiorex
live.hint: Kiorex has approved and activated your pharmacy.

branch.title: Branches
branch.hours: Use standard hours (Sat to Thu 09:00 to 23:00)

terms.body: I accept the Kiorex marketplace terms (version {{version}}). Kiorex handles patient payment; Kiorly Pharmacy stays my system of record.

payout.label: Payout label (for example: Main settlement account)

kiorexConnect.requested: Request sent. Kiorex will review it.

enrolment.label: Enrolment code from Kiorex
enrolment.hint: Kiorex gives you a one-time code to start the connection. Paste it here. It is used once and is not stored.

decision.CHANGES_REQUESTED: Kiorex asked for changes before it can approve your request. The details were sent to the contact e-mail of your request. Fix the open steps, then send the request again.
decision.REJECTED: Kiorex did not approve this request. Your organisation keeps working on its own. Contact Kiorex support if you think this is a mistake.
decision.PAUSED: Kiorex paused your listing. Patients cannot book you until it is resumed. Contact Kiorex support.

kiorexConnect.rotated: New credentials were sent to Kiorex. Copy them now: they are shown once.
kiorexConnect.secretsOnce: Shown once. Store them in your password manager.

passport.title: You are live: switch your team to Kiorex Passport
passport.body: Make Passport the default sign-in and ask staff to link their phone to Passport. Both sign-in methods stay available.

err.KIOREX_UNREACHABLE: Kiorex could not be reached. Nothing was sent. Try again.
err.ENROLMENT_CODE_REQUIRED: Enter the enrolment code Kiorex gave you.
err.ENROLMENT_CODE_INVALID: That enrolment code is not valid. Copy it exactly as Kiorex gave it to you.
err.ENROLMENT_CODE_REJECTED: Kiorex did not accept the enrolment code. Check it, or ask Kiorex for a new one.
err.KIOREX_BUSY: Kiorex is busy right now. Try again shortly.
err.PAYOUT_LOOKS_LIKE_ACCOUNT_NUMBER: Enter a short label only. Bank details are never stored here
err.PAYOUT_LABEL_INVALID: Enter a short label (2 to 40 characters)
err.TERMS_VERSION_MISMATCH: The terms changed: reload the page

kiorexMarketing.headline: Reach more customers with Kiorex
kiorexMarketing.intro: Your pharmacy keeps working exactly as it does today. Kiorex is an optional way for people nearby to find you and order.

search.title: Found in Kiorex search
search.body: People near you find your branches on Kiorex, with your opening hours and delivery area.

orders.title: Online orders for pickup or delivery
orders.body: Customers send an order from Kiorex and choose to collect it or have it delivered.

prepaid.title: Orders can arrive already paid
prepaid.body: Kiorex orders can be paid online before you prepare them.

queue.title: Same workflow, no double entry
queue.body: Kiorex orders arrive in your Orders screen next to your normal work.

rx.title: You stay in charge of prescriptions
rx.body: A pharmacist decides on every prescription order, and controlled medicines are never accepted online.

prepare.title: Get ready
prepare.body: Finish the checklist below: branches, priced catalogue, opening hours and delivery area, licence and terms.

request.title: Ask to go live
request.body: Accept the marketplace terms and send your request.

review.title: Kiorex reviews
review.body: The Kiorex team reviews your request. You can see the status here.

live.title: Go live
live.body: Your doctors appear in Kiorex search and patients can book.

kiorexMarketing.fee: Kiorex charges {{fee}} for each new patient who books through Kiorex and attends the visit. This is the fee published for your market; you see and accept the exact terms before anything goes live.
kiorexMarketing.feeUnconfigured: Fees are confirmed by the Kiorex team before you go live. You will see and accept them before anything is published.

reassure.optional: Connecting is optional. Your practice works fully without it.
reassure.reversible: It is reversible: you can pause your listing at any time.
reassure.data: You keep your data and your sign-in. Nothing is moved or copied away.
reassure.choose: You choose which branches take Kiorex orders.

kiorexMarketing.talkIntro: Leave your details and someone from Kiorex will contact you at the time you choose. Nothing is changed in your account.

form.name: Your name
form.note: Anything you would like us to know (optional)
form.consent: I agree that Kiorex may contact me about connecting my organisation.
form.contactHint: Give a phone number or an e-mail (or both).
form.sent: Thank you. The Kiorex team will contact you.
form.sentAgain: We already have your request. Send it again to update your details.

errors.CONTACT_REQUIRED: Give a phone number or an e-mail.
errors.KIOREX_UNREACHABLE: Kiorex could not be reached. Nothing was sent. Try again.
errors.KIOREX_BUSY: Too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.KIOREX_REJECTED_REQUEST: Kiorex could not accept the request. Try again later.
errors.KIOREX_NOT_CONFIGURED: This installation is not connected to Kiorex.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Nothing was sent.

homeCard.title: Connect to Kiorex
homeCard.body: Optional: let people nearby find your pharmacy and order on Kiorex. Your pharmacy keeps working as it does today.
homeCard.show: Show the Kiorex card on the home page again
homeCard.shown: The card will show on your home page again.

waiting.title: Kiorex is reviewing your request
waiting.body: You do not need to do anything. Kiorex reviews it and your listings go live automatically once approved. This page refreshes by itself.
waiting.n1: The Kiorex team checks your documents and details.
waiting.n2: If something is missing they ask for a change and you see it here.
waiting.n3: When approved, your doctors appear in Kiorex search.

attention.howTo: Fix the open steps in the checklist, then send the request again.
attention.howToPaused: Contact Kiorex support to resume. Patients cannot book you meanwhile.

live.title: Kiorex at a glance
live.listingLiveBody: Patients can find you and place orders. Pausing hides every location from Kiorex until you resume; nothing else changes.
live.listingPausedBody: No new Kiorex orders arrive. Orders already placed are not affected. Resume when you are ready.

kiorexDoor.unavailable: Kiorex information is available to clinic owners and managers.
